## Contact Us

Have a place we should look into?  
A hotel making sustainability claims that feel a little too polished?  
A thoughtful stay that actually walks the talk?

Send it our way.

```{=html}
<form class="contact-form" action="https://formspree.io/f/YOUR-FORM-ID" method="POST">

  <div class="form-row">
    <div class="form-group">
      <label for="name">Name <span>*</span></label>
      <input type="text" id="name" name="name" required>
    </div>

    <div class="form-group">
      <label for="phone">Phone</label>
      <input type="text" id="phone" name="phone">
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="form-group">
    <label for="email">Email <span>*</span></label>
    <input type="email" id="email" name="email" required>
  </div>

  <div class="form-group">
    <label for="message">Message <span>*</span></label>
    <textarea id="message" name="message" rows="7" required></textarea>
  </div>

  <button type="submit">Send Message</button>

</form>
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## No Fluff Promise

We are interested in honest conversations, not paid praise.

If a stay is hosted, sponsored, gifted, discounted, or connected to a brand partnership, that will always be clearly disclosed.

:::
